title: The next episode and a film about to be resumed are ready before Play
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "Play starts in seconds and keeps up. The next episode and a film they are about to resume are ready before they press Play." Nothing is made before it is asked for today.
acceptanceCriteria: The next episode, and a film a viewer is about to resume, start as fast as a film sent as it is, even when they must be converted.
Getting ready never slows anything a viewer is waiting for, and what it makes counts toward the budget and goes when unused.
notes: Coarse: sharpened when stage 3 is planned in detail.
